source: Indian residential comfortable-size targets per architecture-v2 Component 9 worked example. C9 v1 keyed by (category, is_master).
schema_notes: target_m2 is the comfortable size (above liveability_min, well below max).
is_master variants are listed where applicable (BEDROOM, BATHROOM); LIVING / KITCHEN / POOJA / UTILITY have only is_master=false rows.

For BATHROOM the row is keyed COMBINED-subtype only; other subtypes fall back to the COMBINED target (rationale: BATH_ONLY / WC_ONLY are reduced fixtures, so target should not exceed COMBINED's; targets KB v1 keeps lookup simple).

Q14 (open spec question): max_m2 multipliers may eventually move into this KB. v1 keeps multipliers in code (targets_kb.py PER_CATEGORY_MAX_MULTIPLIER); migration is a v0.8+ spec amendment per Rule 8.
